name: Elasticsearch Learning-to-Rank (LTR) plugin (o19s/elasticsearch-learning-to-rank)

vendor.company: Open Source Connections (OSC), with major contributions from Wikimedia Foundation, Snagajob, Bonsai, and Yelp
vendor.backing: OSS (Apache-2.0). Note: the o19s plugin is the COMMUNITY/OSS plugin for the open-source Elasticsearch distribution. Elastic later shipped its own first-party LTR for Elastic-licensed ES 8.12+; they are distinct. This dossier covers the o19s plugin.
vendor.hq: Open Source Connections - Charlottesville, Virginia, USA
vendor.scale: ~1.5k GitHub stars. De-facto reference LTR implementation for OSS Elasticsearch; also the upstream that AWS OpenSearch LTR and the OpenSearch LTR plugin forked from. Production users historically include Wikimedia (Wikipedia search), Yelp, Snagajob.

ports: 5601/tcp (Kibana, common co-deployment - adjacent, not the plugin)

verification_primitive.probe: GET http://TARGET:9200/_ltr  (read-only; no body). Optionally follow with GET /_ltr/_stats and GET /_ltr/_featureset.
verification_primitive.success_signal: HTTP 200 returning a JSON object listing feature stores (default '_default_' and/or named stores). Contrast: 401/403 = ES security ON (surface present, access not exercised); 400 'no handler found for uri [/_ltr]' or 404 = ES open but LTR plugin NOT installed; connection refused = node not reachable.
verification_primitive.impact_when_open: Read confirms the LTR plugin is installed and unauthenticated. GET /_ltr/_featureset/* then leaks the relevance design: index field names, query templates, personalization parameters (e.g. user lat/lon, user-segment fields), and any painless script_feature logic - reconnaissance into the underlying data model. An open node is by definition an open Elasticsearch, so the real impact is the full ES dataset (read/write/delete), with /_ltr write routes (PUT /_ltr, DELETE /_ltr, POST _createmodel) as an additional integrity/availability surface.

endpoints.returns: Elasticsearch root banner JSON: name, cluster_name, cluster_uuid, version.number, version.build_flavor/lucene_version, and tagline 'You Know, for Search'. Confirms an open ES node (host for the plugin).
Lists all LTR feature stores on the cluster (ListStoresAction). 200 with a stores list = LTR plugin present AND unauth-readable. Cleanest plugin-presence + open-auth signal.
Plugin usage/performance stats across nodes (RestLTRStats, base URI '/_ltr/_stats'; also /_ltr/_stats/{stat} and /_ltr/_stats/nodes/{nodeId}). Confirms plugin install + node topology when open.
{"exists": true|false} for a named/default feature store index.
Lists feature sets (supports ?prefix=). Reveals feature/query design, field names, personalization params (e.g. user lat/lon templates).
Full feature set definition: mustache/painless/derived templates -> leaks index field names and query logic.
Direct read of the hidden feature-store index documents (bypasses the _ltr abstraction) on an open ES.
Initializes the default .ltrstore feature store (WRITE). Open-write proof primitive.
Creates a feature set, including script_feature painless templates (WRITE; scripting surface).
Destroys the entire default feature store (destructive WRITE).
